name: Biology AP: Cellmoor
subtitle: Biology AP Mocks & FRQs
shortDescription: Practice AP Biology with original questions, six interactive benches, free-response sets and timed mock exams. No account needed. Works offline.
longDescription:
Learn and practise every topic of AP Biology in one calm, colourful app. Cellmoor covers all eight units and all 60 topics of the College Board course description, with short lessons, original practice questions, interactive labs and exam-style mocks that adapt to what you get wrong.

### What You Get
- All 8 units and 60 topics: short lesson cards, a list of what you should be able to do, and a real-world hook for each topic.
- 568 original practice questions (446 multiple-choice and 122 numeric), at least 8 for every topic, each with a worked solution and a note on why each wrong answer is wrong.
- Fix it: after every quiz, each miss links straight back to the lesson card, the matching lab and the real-world build.
- Adaptive practice: Cellmoor tracks your mastery of every topic, chooses the weakest topics first and brings older topics back before you forget them.
- Free response, marked by you: 23 free-response sets in the long and short styles, with point-by-point rubrics so you can score your own writing honestly.
- Mock exams: a quick 15-question check, and a full mock with 60 multiple-choice and 6 free-response questions in two 90-minute sections.
- Eight interactive labs: genetic crosses and chi-square, enzyme kinetics, osmosis and water potential, Hardy-Weinberg and drift, population growth, transcription and translation, photosynthesis and respiration energy, and AP investigation statistics.
- Two ways to learn: follow the Classical unit order, or switch to the Real-World route and solve problems such as designing a safe sports drink or finding the fault in a signal.
- Coverage screen: exact counts of topics, lessons, questions and labs for every unit, so you can see what is in the app.
- Other boards map: an optional, muted chip on each topic shows similar content in GCSE, A Level and IB Biology, so you can prepare extra material or compare courses. It is approximate, so check your own specification.
- Text size from 50 to 300 percent for lessons and formulas, tablet layouts, offline use and no account.

### Original Content
Every lesson, question, solution and rubric in Cellmoor was written for this app. It does not use released or past exam questions and it is not official College Board material. Numeric answers are checked by calculation before they ship.

### Optional Sharing
On first launch you see a short notice. You can choose whether to share anonymous usage and device information, and you can send feedback or diagnostics from Settings whenever you wish. Details are in the Privacy Policy.

AP is a registered trademark of the College Board, which is not affiliated with and does not endorse this app. Cellmoor is an independent study aid.
